pairs.target: dìyīcì huòzhǔn mō nà duì tóngtiáo shí , tǎ wéi yǐjīng liàn guò sānhuí pǔtōng cèliáng .
pairs.english: By the time Tavi was first allowed to touch that pair of copper rods, he had practiced ordinary measurements three times.
pairs.hanzi: 第一次获准摸那对铜条时，塔维已经练过三回普通测量。

pairs.target: bǎi lǎoshī bǎ tā jiāoshànglái de zhǐ yìzhāng zhāng tānkāi , cóng dìyītáng huà wāi de xiàn fān dào zuótiān de jìlù .
pairs.english: Instructor Bai spread out his submitted sheets one by one, turning from the crooked line of his first class to yesterday's records.
pairs.hanzi: 柏老师把他交上来的纸一张张摊开，从第一堂划歪的线翻到昨天的记录。

pairs.target: nàtiān tā shǒuzhǎng tiē shàng tóngtiáo , què méiyǒu jiè xìng , liǎngbiān shuǐdài de wēndù réng lüèyǒu shàngshēng . zhǎngxīn běnlái jiù rè , bùnéng bǎ zhège suàn chéngběn shì .
pairs.english: That day his palms touched the rods without borrowing properties, yet both water bags still warmed a little. Palms were naturally warm; this couldn't count as skill.
pairs.hanzi: 那天他手掌贴上铜条，却没有借性，两边水袋的温度仍略有上升。掌心本来就热，不能把这个算成本事。

pairs.target: hòulái huàn le shuǐ , děng gèchù qǐshǐ wēndù xiāngjìn , tā cái bǎ bù shīshù de nà yìlún zuò wánzhěng .
pairs.english: After changing the water and waiting until the starting temperatures were similar throughout, he completed that noncasting round.
pairs.hanzi: 后来换了水，等各处起始温度相近，他才把不施术的那一轮做完整。

pairs.target: jīntiān de zhuāngzhì háishì nà yítào . liǎnggēn tóngtiáo de zhěngjiàn tǐjī , cáiliào hé wàixíng dōu jīngguò lǎoshī héduì , rè duān jìn zài xiāngtóng de wēnshuǐ lǐ , lěng duān gè kàozhe shuǐdài .
pairs.english: Today's apparatus was the same. The teacher had checked both rods' whole volumes, materials and shapes; the warm ends sat in identical warm water, each cool end against a water bag.
pairs.hanzi: 今天的装置还是那一套。两根铜条的整件体积、材料和外形都经过老师核对，热端浸在相同的温水里，冷端各靠着水袋。

pairs.target: mù zhào dǎngzhù kào shuǐcáo de bùfen , zhī lùchū zhōngjiān gòng shǒu pèng de duǎn duàn , mōshàngqù wēnwēnde , bìng bú tàng .
pairs.english: Wooden guards covered the sections near the troughs, leaving only short central patches for hand contact, mildly warm to the touch, not hot.
pairs.hanzi: 木罩挡住靠水槽的部分，只露出中间供手碰的短段，摸上去温温的，并不烫。

pairs.target: tèlún zuòzài duìmiàn , tì tā bào liǎngzhī xì yè zhù de wèizhì . tāmen xiān zuò yìlún kòngbái cèliáng , zài huànshuǐ zhòngzhì . bǎi lǎoshī quèrèn dúshù , cái shìyì tǎ wéi bǎ liǎngzhīshǒu fēnbié fàngwěn .
pairs.english: Teren sat opposite, calling out the positions of the two thin liquid columns. They took baseline measurements, then replaced the water and reset. After confirming the readings, Bai signaled Tavi to settle each hand in place.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦坐在对面，替他报两支细液柱的位置。他们先做一轮空白测量，再换水重置。柏老师确认读数，才示意塔维把两只手分别放稳。

pairs.target: " jīntiān zhī shì ràng zhè yìbiān bǐ píngcháng chuán dé mànxiē . lìngyìbiān de biànhuà yóu wǒ kàn , búyào zìjǐ zhuī zhe zhùzi pǎo . "
pairs.english: “Today just try to make this side conduct more slowly than usual. I'll watch the other side's change; don't chase the columns yourself.”
pairs.hanzi: “今天只试让这一边比平常传得慢些。另一边的变化由我看，不要自己追着柱子跑。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bì le yíxià yǎnjīng . tā zài tiě shàng zhǎo guò de nàzhǒng sōngjǐn gǎn , xiàng yìgēn shúxī de xìshéng , zhǐyào xīnlǐ shāoshāo yì dā , jiù huì xiǎng wǎng nàbiān qiān . kě tóngtiáo méiyǒu gěi tā tóngyàng de huíyìng .
pairs.english: Tavi closed his eyes briefly. The sense of give he had sought in iron was like a familiar thin cord; the slightest mental touch made him want to pull that way. But the copper rods gave him no such response.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维闭了一下眼睛。他在铁上找过的那种松紧感，像一根熟悉的细绳，只要心里稍稍一搭，就会想往那边牵。可铜条没有给他同样的回应。

pairs.target: tā shì zhe bú qù zhǎo sōngjǐn , fǎnér lìkè bù zhīdào gāi zhùyì shénme . zhǎngxīn de wēn yì hěn shízài , shuǐdài de biànhuà què gé zhe zhuōzi , jǐcì hūxī guòqù , tā juéde zuǒbiān sìhū màn le , yòu yíxīn shì tèlún bàoshù de shēngyīn ràng tā zhème xiǎng .
pairs.english: Trying not to seek that give, he immediately lost track of what to attend to. The warmth in his palms was tangible, but the water bags' changes were across the table. After several breaths he felt the left side seemed slower, then suspected Teren's counting was making him think so.
pairs.hanzi: 他试着不去找松紧，反而立刻不知道该注意什么。掌心的温意很实在，水袋的变化却隔着桌子，几次呼吸过去，他觉得左边似乎慢了，又疑心是特伦报数的声音让他这么想。

pairs.target: " tíng . " bǎi lǎoshī shuō . tā liǎngshǒu réng tiēzhe tóngtiáo , àn jiào guò de cìxù shōuhuí zhùyì . lǎoshī méiyǒu ràng tā zài shì , érshì děng dúshù jì wán , jiào tā sōngshǒu .
pairs.english: “Stop,” Bai said. With both hands still touching the rods, he withdrew his attention in the order taught. The teacher didn't let him try again; she waited until the readings were recorded, then told him to release them.
pairs.hanzi:
“停。”柏老师说。
他两手仍贴着铜条，按教过的次序收回注意。老师没有让他再试，而是等读数记完，叫他松手。

pairs.target: yòushǒu mǔzhǐ yā zài mùjià biānshàng tàijiǔ , liúxià le yídào qiǎnbái yìn , róu liǎngxià jiù xiāo le .
pairs.english: His right thumb had pressed the edge of the wooden frame too long, leaving a pale mark that vanished after a couple of rubs.
pairs.hanzi: 右手拇指压在木架边上太久，留下了一道浅白印，揉两下就消了。

pairs.target: tèlún bǎ zhǐ zhuǎnguò lái . liǎngbiān dōu méiyǒu chāochū xiānqián jǐlún pǔtōng cèliáng de bōdòng , bùnéng quèrèn yǒu chéng duì de biànhuà . tǎ wéi kàn le bàntiān , rěnbúzhù shuō zìjǐ gāngcái quèshí juéde zuǒbiān màn .
pairs.english: Teren turned the paper around. Neither side exceeded the variation in earlier ordinary measurements; no paired change could be confirmed. After studying it a long while, Tavi couldn't help saying he had truly felt the left side slow down.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦把纸转过来。两边都没有超出先前几轮普通测量的波动，不能确认有成对的变化。塔维看了半天，忍不住说自己刚才确实觉得左边慢。

pairs.target: bǎi lǎoshī zhǐzhe tā jìlù de shíjiān . " nǐ xiān dīng zuǒbiān , yòubiān wǎn kàn le yì xī . juéde màn , kěyǐ xiě zài pángbiān , bùnéng tì zhè liǎngháng shù zuòzhèng . " tā méi huàdiào tā de gǎnjué , zhī jiāng nàjùhuà yí dào le kòngbáichù .
pairs.english: Bai pointed to his recorded times. “You watched the left first, the right a breath later. You may write that it felt slower beside it, but that can't testify for these two rows.” She didn't cross out his feeling, only moved the sentence into a blank space.
pairs.hanzi:
柏老师指着他记录的时间。“你先盯左边，右边晚看了一息。觉得慢，可以写在旁边，不能替这两行数作证。”
她没划掉他的感觉，只将那句话移到了空白处。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuò huíqù , kàn tèlún zhǔnbèi . duìfāng xiān cuō le cuōshǒu , yòu tíngzhù , wèn zhèyàng huì buhuì bǎ qǐchū tiáojiàn nòngluàn . bǎi lǎoshī ràng tā děngyīděng , chóngxīn liáng guò jiēchù chù , cái kāishǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi sat back to watch Teren prepare. Teren rubbed his hands, then stopped and asked whether that would disrupt the initial conditions. Bai had him wait, remeasuring the contact patches before starting.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐回去，看特伦准备。对方先搓了搓手，又停住，问这样会不会把起初条件弄乱。柏老师让他等一等，重新量过接触处，才开始。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiēguò bàoshù de huó , tūrán lǐjiě gāngcái tèlún wèishénme zuò dé yídòngbudòng : yídàn zhuī cuò yè zhù , zài gǎnhuílái , shíjiān jiù guò le .
pairs.english: Taking over the counting, Tavi suddenly understood why Teren had sat so still: follow the wrong column, and by the time you returned the moment was gone.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维接过报数的活，突然理解刚才特伦为什么坐得一动不动：一旦追错液柱，再赶回来，时间就过了。

pairs.target: zhè yícì , liǎngtiáo shàngshēng de jìlù shāoshāo fēnkāi , lǎoshī kànguò lìngyìzǔ dúshù , zhǔnxǔ tèlún jiéshù . chóngxīn huànshuǐ héduì hòu , biànhuà huídào pǔtōng fànwéi . tā zài zhǐ shàng xiěxià " xiǎofú , jiēchù zhōng ", méiyǒu ràng tā duō zuò yíbiàn .
pairs.english: This time the two rising traces diverged slightly. After checking another set of readings, the teacher let Teren finish. With fresh water and another check, the changes returned to the ordinary range. She wrote “small, during contact,” and didn't let him repeat it.
pairs.hanzi: 这一次，两条上升的记录稍稍分开，老师看过另一组读数，准许特伦结束。重新换水核对后，变化回到普通范围。她在纸上写下“小幅、接触中”，没有让他多做一遍。

pairs.target: xiàkèshí , tèlún zǒu dé hěn màn , xiàng hái zài mòbèi shùzì . tǎ wéi zhuī shàng tā , wèn gāngcái dàodǐ mō dào le shénme .
pairs.english: After class, Teren walked slowly, as if still silently reciting numbers. Tavi caught up and asked what exactly he had felt.
pairs.hanzi: 下课时，特伦走得很慢，像还在默背数字。塔维追上他，问刚才到底摸到了什么。

pairs.target: " nǐ bié xiào . " tèlún shuō , " xiàng zǒng xiǎng bǎ liǎngshànmén yìqǐ tuīkāi , kě wǒ zhī gāi gù mén zhóu . yě bú duì , wǒ xiànzài shuō bù míngbái . "
pairs.english: “Don't laugh,” Teren said. “Like wanting to push two doors open together when I should only attend to the hinges. That's not right either. I can't explain it yet.”
pairs.hanzi: “你别笑。”特伦说，“像总想把两扇门一起推开，可我只该顾门轴。也不对，我现在说不明白。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi běnlái qīdài yíjù néng zhàozhe zuò dehuà , tīng wán yǒuxiē shīwàng . tèlún kàn chūlái , liǎnhóng le , shuō búshìgùyì bù jiǎng .
pairs.english: Tavi had hoped for words he could follow, and felt disappointed. Teren noticed, blushed, and said he wasn't deliberately withholding anything.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维本来期待一句能照着做的话，听完有些失望。特伦看出来，脸红了，说不是故意不讲。

pairs.target: " wǒ zhīdào . " tǎ wéi shuō . tā xiǎngqǐ mǐlā nà jù bù zhīdào , yòu bǔ le yíjù , " wǒ zhǐshì xiǎng lìkè huì . gēn nǐ méiguānxì . "
pairs.english: “I know,” Tavi said. Remembering Mira's words about not knowing, he added, “I just want to be able to do it immediately. It's nothing to do with you.”
pairs.hanzi: “我知道。”塔维说。他想起米拉那句不知道，又补了一句，“我只是想立刻会。跟你没关系。”

pairs.target: tèlún sōng le kǒuqì , què méi jí zhe ānwèi tā . zǒu dào lóutīkǒu , tā wèn yè dì sài nàgēn tí shéng háiyǒu méiyǒu . tāmen hòulái zhā de jié lè dé jiānbǎng téng .
pairs.english: Teren relaxed, but didn't rush to console him. At the stairs, he asked whether the carrying rope from the night race was still around. The knot his team had tied afterward had hurt their shoulders.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦松了口气，却没急着安慰他。走到楼梯口，他问夜递赛那根提绳还有没有。他们后来扎的结勒得肩膀疼。

alignment.english: whether the carrying rope from the night race was still around

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō shéng shì mǐlā de , kěyǐ wèn , bié cóng tā zhuōshàng ná . " wǒ zhècì huì wèn . " tèlún shuō .
pairs.english: Tavi said the rope was Mira's; he could ask, but shouldn't take it from her desk. “I'll ask this time,” Teren said.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维说绳是米拉的，可以问，别从她桌上拿。
“我这次会问。”特伦说。

pairs.target: liǎng rén zài lóutīkǒu fēnkāi . tǎ wéi huí sùshè , bǎ pǔtōng cèliáng de zhǐ chóngxīn tān píng , pángbiān liúchū yìlán , xiěxià : wǒ yǐwéi fāshēng de shì . tā hái méi xiǎng hǎo nà lán gāi zěnme tián , pà wò cóng chuángshàng fānxiàlái , xiān bǎ yíkuài bǐng fàngzài le shàngmiàn .
pairs.english: They parted at the stairs. Back in the dormitory, Tavi spread his ordinary measurement sheets out again and left a column beside them, headed: What I thought happened. Before he could decide how to fill it, Pavo rolled off the bed and put a piece of flatbread on it first.
pairs.hanzi: 两人在楼梯口分开。塔维回宿舍，把普通测量的纸重新摊平，旁边留出一栏，写下：我以为发生的事。他还没想好那栏该怎么填，帕沃从床上翻下来，先把一块饼放在了上面。
